# Review: two native parametric builds

Assignment `review-749d461469f8749e`; both reviewed base generators remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
`d83b3801c134` (`generator.py` SHA-256 `466826e3a993e924fc29d6a00bef000af2741a645a7ac41a13756fca4dfae781`): added an exact-canonical marker 1→2 default plus a marker 2→1 vector variant.
`39ad03f74acb` (`generator.py` SHA-256 `8d19e3788a62e01cd90bd19b3fdabdbb6c3b32090bb8ec9af8db0f4177482068`): added an exact-canonical all-segments default plus a longest-orientation → perpendicular-interiors relay.
Both defaults match the selected catalog Racket source byte-for-byte; no reference rule or catalog approval flag changed.
Focused task tests pass for both targets; all supported 2–6 demonstration counts retain four distinct queries and substantive 30x30 cases.
Both source-bound authoring preflights pass protected Racket for two settings × seeds 0 and 17; these are not owner qualifications.
Both protected-Racket causal witnesses replay and change final output under the declared wrong vector/orientation intermediate.
Forty-seed bounded audits cover 160 setting episodes total and found no declared-rival teaching hole or finite equivalence.
Both sequential public projections verify 4 episodes / 16 one-query views, including first-turn hidden-field invariance and visible-change controls.
Remaining limit: these are reviewer-ready prototypes, not accepted production families; exact-source owner qualification and fresh acceptance remain pending, and training admission is false.
Routine integration should apply `patches/source.patch`, replay the packaged evidence, then run the existing owner acceptance path for both exact sources.

## d83b3801c134

The canonical setting computes marker 1→2 displacement; the alternative reverses it. Inputs are matched across settings, keep all green cells in bounds under both signed vectors, contain multiple disconnected green components, and distinguish the two rules on every generated pair. The 40-seed audit retained 80 episodes, 90 distinct selected vectors, and at least 20 green cells in the 30x30 stress scenes. Primary evidence: `checks/d83b3801c134/qualification/qualification.json`, `checks/d83b3801c134/causal/witness.json`, `checks/d83b3801c134/first-turn.json`, and `repo/generators/d83b3801c134/workspace/parametric/evidence/current/audit.json`.
